name: Tilt Card
description: A card that tilts toward the pointer while its contents lift off the surface at different depths.

props.name: maxTilt
props.description: Largest tilt on each axis, in degrees.

props.name: perspective
props.description: CSS perspective distance in pixels. Smaller values look more dramatic.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the hover area, which also sets the card's width.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the tilting surface. It is a card by default: rounded-2xl, hairline border, bg-card, p-5. Avoid overflow-hidden, opacity and filter here; they flatten the 3D effect.

props.name: children
props.description: The card's content, with TiltCardItem around anything that should lift.

props.name: depth
props.description: How far the item rises toward the viewer while the card is hovered or focused, in pixels, from 0 to 100.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render, for example "h3" or "p".

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Any wrapper between the body and an item needs [transform-style:preserve-3d] to keep the depth.
